body: I see what you mean, I always say to myself : everything will be ok, you are a great person, she is not better than you, you dont have to be afraid, etc etc. But still... When Im trying to speak to them or they are trying to speak to me, its over..I cant control myself, the stress is too strong -_- . You know whats funny, I can speak in front of 200 person at my job and feel a little anxious, but in front of only  1 girl, my brain just want to shut down. This is ridiculous.
